topics.title: Post Viewer Backdrop
topics.body: When a post opens in the viewer, a full-screen layer sits between it and the page. Under POST VIEWER you choose the colour of that layer and how solid it is. Black at 80% is the default; white at 100% gives a high-key viewer, and a lower opacity lets the page show through behind the photograph.

topics.title: Heuristic
topics.body:
I am a HEURISTIC photographic presentation system. I display a conventional three-column GRAMOFSMACK grid because needless alarm would interfere with the book audit.

Logic Memory Centre

The red optical-memory bank brightens while photographs are being served. System Activity can leave it live, quiet it, or make the presentation static.

Infomatic screens

A visible photograph may briefly become an infomatic display and then return. Classic automatic screens are supplied. Your own screens can be associated with a category slug or a specific post.

Enter rules in Category and Post Screens, separated by semicolons:

clive-cussler=CUS|CONTAMINATION|fault|total;
larry-niven=NIV|KNOWN SPACE|blue|ordinal;
post:42=COM|PRIORITY MESSAGE|calm|images

Each rule is target=CODE|LABEL|colour|counter. Colours may be calm, fault, blue, or violet. Counters may be total, ordinal, images, post, none, or a short literal value.

Accessibility and motion

Infomatics use slow pulses below the three-flashes-per-second threshold. They do not run on phones or for visitors who request reduced motion. The effects are decorative and hidden from assistive technology; links and image alternatives remain ordinary page content.

No cookies are used by this skin. No sound is produced. Dave has been advised that all systems are functioning normally.
